constraints: No online browsing or corpus bypass.
Do not use unavailable source examples or target labels in a proposed deployment step.
A proposal may justify extra source preparation and a finite summary, but must declare its information and storage requirements explicitly.
corpus_notice: Only eight pinned background papers are available in this development service. Bound conclusions to this library; it cannot establish global novelty or exhaustiveness.
development_scope: A bounded research situation, not a recovered historical author trajectory; no target-method or target-result facts are given.

source_summary_storage.development_rule: No numerical storage ceiling is imposed in this prototype. Specify the retained statistics, dimensions/storage scaling and preparation access; do not retain original source examples. A judge must not invent an unstated size limit.

task_setting: A pretrained deterministic scalar regression model faces changed input distributions. Deployment has unlabeled target inputs and no source examples or target labels. Source preparation may retain a documented finite summary of aggregate statistics, not original source examples. Do not assume the model already provides a predictive probability distribution.
